newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on depreciation.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on depreciation.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka finished weaker at 44.6480/6500 to the dollar on Monday following a central bank adjustment of the currency, dealers said.
The central bank readjusted the taka's exchange rates from Monday to Tk 44.45/65 per dollar against previous at Tk 44.00/20.
The taka was quoted in a wide spread at 44.6300/6600 per dollar in early trade, but deals centred mostly at the 44.6500 level throughout the session.
The call money rates closed flat at 7.5 to 8.0 percent.
